title: Refactor JSON Resource References to Semio Repo ID System
description: All JSON files in .semio-repo should use the semio repo id system for resource references. Convert goal paths like AI-OPTIMIZED-REPO/REPO-CLIENT to emoji-prefixed flat format like 🎯aioptimizedrepo🎯repoclient. Also convert contributor references and parent goal references. Update CLI code to handle the new format.

interactions.summary: Refactored all .semio-repo JSON files to use semio repo ID system (emoji-prefixed flat IDs). Migration script converted 1498 references across all ticket.json and goal.json files. Updated Go CLI with MarshalJSON/UnmarshalJSON boundary conversion for Ticket and Goal structs, added goalPathToSemioID/semioIDToGoalPath/contributorGithubToSemioID/semioIDToContributorGithub conversion functions, fixed Goal.GetID() for hierarchical format. All 15 relevant tests pass including 7 new round-trip tests. Fixed pre-existing hhmmss compile error in logHook.
